title.narrative: Advancing on articulate actions for a universal and solidary social security

description.narrative: The project is implemented in Costa Rica and Dominican Republic. The main outcome areas it contributes to are advancing equality and workers´ rights. The main rights holders are informal and precarious workers in Costa Rica and the Dominican Republic. Through capacity building, alliance building, campaigns, and advocacy the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between Trade Union Confederation of the Americas (TUCA), LO Sweden and The Palme Center.Other Donors to the OrganisationThere are no other donors to the project. TUCA receives project funding from DGB (Germany) and the EU commission, for other projects related to global value chains and the sustainable development goals. The Palme Center will attempt to establish a closer contact and coordination with them and other funders and explore possibilities for harmonization and avoid overlap.Project ObjectiveThe project objective is to advance trade unions´ policy and reform proposals on areas related to social protection, taxation and formalising the informal economy, and their impact on the same issues.Actor groupsThe main actors within the different actor groups are as follows. Decision-makers: governments, progressive political parties, and employers. Actors working in cooperation: trade union affiliates in each country, social groups, and allies (such as churches, universities, and NGOs), non-affiliated worker groups (cooperatives, organisations representing informal workers), International organisations (ILO, UN, as well as global trade union federations) among others. Lastly, the main rights holders in the project are informal and precarious workers in the selected countries.
